description: Calculate Vedic dasha periods with Moon Dasha in any of seven systems: Vimshottari (default), Yogini, Ashtottari, Chara (K. N. Rao), Kaal Chakra, Narayana and Sudarshan Chakra. Returns the Mahadashas with their dates to the 120th year of life, across cycles (Sudarshan Chakra: the 12 years of the running cycle), the Mahadasha, Antardasha and Pratyantardasha running on a given day (default today; Sudarshan Chakra: the year and its month), and the running Mahadasha's Antardashas, plus a link to the dashas on moondasha.com. Needs the birth date, the local birth time and the birthplace (a place_id from find_place). If the person does not know the birth time, ask for a best guess and set time_is_approximate. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

as_of.description: The day whose running periods to show, YYYY-MM-DD, from the birth date to the 120th year of life. Default today.

ayanamsa.description: Default Lahiri. Krishnamurti is the KP ayanamsa.

dasha_year.description: The year the periods count in: true_sidereal (default), mean_sidereal, true_tropical, mean_tropical or savana (360 days). Set it only when the person asks for one.

node.description: Rahu and Ketu by the mean node (default) or the true node.

place_id.description: The place_id find_place returned for the birthplace.

system.description: The dasha system: vimshottari (default), yogini, ashtottari, chara (K. N. Rao), kaal_chakra, narayana or sudarshan_chakra. Use the one the person asks for.

time.description: Local clock time at the birthplace, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. Required: if the person does not know it, ask for their best guess and set time_is_approximate.

time_is_approximate.description: Set when the birth time is a guess: the answer then shows the running periods an hour either side and how far the dates move.

name: dasha_periods

cycle.description: The Mahadasha's cycle, 1 for the first: a later round of Yogini, Ashtottari or Narayana, or a repeat of Chara or Kaal Chakra.

end.description: Local time on the birth's clock, ISO 8601 with its UTC offset; Julian when calendar is julian.

ruler.description: Who rules the period: a planet, a yogini with its planet, a sign, or (Sudarshan Chakra) the signs from the ascendant, the Moon and the Sun.

start.description: Local time on the birth's clock, ISO 8601 with its UTC offset; Julian when calendar is julian.

dates_move_days.description: How far an hour's error moves the running Mahadasha's start or end, in days; null when the hour changes the sequence of periods itself.

as_of_moment.description: The moment the running periods are read at: noon of as_of on the birth's clock, or the birth itself on a birth day after noon.
